g.text: +12V = protected rail (after D20). Everything on the board runs from it; BATT_IN is the raw J1 pin.

g.desc: +12V = protected rail (after D20). Everything on the board runs from it; BATT_IN is the raw J1 pin.

g.text: 12 V -> 5 V buck, LM2678T-5.0 (260 kHz, integrated N-ch MOSFET, 45 V max input).

g.desc: 12 V -> 5 V buck, LM2678T-5.0 (260 kHz, integrated N-ch MOSFET, 45 V max input).

g.text: Fed from the protected rail: J1-1 -> D20 1N5822 -> RV20 1.5KE30A TVS -> C20 100uF 50V -> here.

g.desc: Fed from the protected rail: J1-1 -> D20 1N5822 -> RV20 1.5KE30A TVS -> C20 100uF 50V -> here.

g.text: The BOOST cap bootstraps the internal high-side gate above VIN - that is why an N-channel part needs it.

g.desc: The BOOST cap bootstraps the internal high-side gate above VIN - that is why an N-channel part needs it.

g.text: FEEDBACK goes straight to +5V: the fixed -5.0 part has the divider inside, so there is none to get wrong.

g.desc: FEEDBACK goes straight to +5V: the fixed -5.0 part has the divider inside, so there is none to get wrong.

g.text: Catch diode must be a real Schottky rated >=2 A (SS34 or STPS5L60); a 1N5819 is 1 A and has no margin.

g.desc: Catch diode must be a real Schottky rated >=2 A (SS34 or STPS5L60); a 1N5819 is 1 A and has no margin.

g.text: Keep the SW loop physically tight: U3 pin 1 -> L1 -> C30 -> GND -> D30 -> back. That loop carries the switching current.

g.desc: Keep the SW loop physically tight: U3 pin 1 -> L1 -> C30 -> GND -> D30 -> back. That loop carries the switching current.

g.text: GROUND-ACTIVE inputs (TRUNK_AJAR = ORN, KEY_IN = BLU/WHT, DOOR = BLK/YEL): +5V -> 1k -> LED -> 1N5819 -> wire. Wire grounded => SENSE low.

g.desc: GROUND-ACTIVE inputs (TRUNK_AJAR = ORN, KEY_IN = BLU/WHT, DOOR = BLK/YEL): +5V -> 1k -> LED -> 1N5819 -> wire. Wire grounded => SENSE low.

g.text: +12V-ACTIVE input (IGN = YEL/BLU): wire -> 1N5819 -> 2.2k -> LED -> GND. Wire at +12V => SENSE low.

g.desc: +12V-ACTIVE input (IGN = YEL/BLU): wire -> 1N5819 -> 2.2k -> LED -> GND. Wire at +12V => SENSE low.

g.text: VSS removed at rev 8: with remote start gone its only use was speed auto-lock; the CM5 taps the cluster wire itself.

g.desc: VSS removed at rev 8: with remote start gone its only use was speed auto-lock; the CM5 taps the cluster wire itself.

g.text: J1 Mini-Fit Jr 16P (odd pins left / even pins right):

g.desc: J1 Mini-Fit Jr 16P (odd pins left / even pins right):

g.text: 9 RS-485 ground return (own wire, not shared with pin 2)

g.desc: 9 RS-485 ground return (own wire, not shared with pin 2)

g.text: hondaPico — Pico W keyless-entry module, 2001 Honda Accord LX (rev 8: stock functions only)

g.desc: hondaPico — Pico W keyless-entry module, 2001 Honda Accord LX (rev 8: stock functions only)

g.text: Scope: the stock keyless-entry feature set, nothing more. Remote start, the YEL/RED unlock-relay stage and their interlocks were removed in rev 8.

g.desc: Scope: the stock keyless-entry feature set, nothing more. Remote start, the YEL/RED unlock-relay stage and their interlocks were removed in rev 8.

g.text: Outputs: six ULN2803A ground-pulse channels (lock, unlock, trunk relay coil, flasher relay coil, horn relay coil, security LED)

g.desc: Outputs: six ULN2803A ground-pulse channels (lock, unlock, trunk relay coil, flasher relay coil, horn relay coil, security LED)

g.text: plus Q1 (harvested MTD3055VL) for the ceiling lamp. Every output line gets 2.2 nF + a P6KE30A TVS (cathode to the line, anode to GND):

g.desc: plus Q1 (harvested MTD3055VL) for the ceiling lamp. Every output line gets 2.2 nF + a P6KE30A TVS (cathode to the line, anode to GND):

g.text: same role as the Alpine board's V270 MOVs, but clamping at 41.4 V instead of 60 V, which the ULN2803A's 50 V rating needs.

g.desc: same role as the Alpine board's V270 MOVs, but clamping at 41.4 V instead of 60 V, which the ULN2803A's 50 V rating needs.

g.text: Inputs are PC817 optos. Trunk and flasher relays are the car's own Mitsuba RC-2201s, back in their harness sockets. See circuits.md.

g.desc: Inputs are PC817 optos. Trunk and flasher relays are the car's own Mitsuba RC-2201s, back in their harness sockets. See circuits.md.

g.text: Ceiling light: GPIO3 -> Q1 grounds the lamp (illuminated entry). D21 passes the door-switch ground to the lamp

g.desc: Ceiling light: GPIO3 -> Q1 grounds the lamp (illuminated entry). D21 passes the door-switch ground to the lamp

g.text: (replaces the harness jumper) while blocking Q1's ground from reaching the DOOR line.

g.desc: (replaces the harness jumper) while blocking Q1's ground from reaching the DOOR line.

g.text: Pin budget after rev 8: 12 GPIOs used, 14 free. J1 has 3 spare pins.

g.desc: Pin budget after rev 8: 12 GPIOs used, 14 free. J1 has 3 spare pins.

g.text: Remote start, if it returns, is its own module on the RS-485 bus.

g.desc: Remote start, if it returns, is its own module on the RS-485 bus.

g.text: Bring-up hardware. TP1-TP4 = +12V / +5V / SW / +3V3; TP5-TP7 = GND loops, one each at the buck,

g.desc: Bring-up hardware. TP1-TP4 = +12V / +5V / SW / +3V3; TP5-TP7 = GND loops, one each at the buck,

g.text: the Pico and the harness end. J7 shorts RUN to GND for a hardware reset without cutting power.

g.desc: the Pico and the harness end. J7 shorts RUN to GND for a hardware reset without cutting power.

g.text: D40 = power good, D41 = heartbeat on GP15. JP1 selects the RS-485 terminator.

g.desc: D40 = power good, D41 = heartbeat on GP15. JP1 selects the RS-485 terminator.

g.text: RS-485: MAX3485 (3.3 V version of the MAX485) run from +3V3, so RO feeds GP9 with no level shifting.

g.desc: RS-485: MAX3485 (3.3 V version of the MAX485) run from +3V3, so RO feeds GP9 with no level shifting.

g.text: DE and /RE tied to GP10: HIGH = transmit, LOW = listen. The 10k PULLDOWN sets the safe default --

g.desc: DE and /RE tied to GP10: HIGH = transmit, LOW = listen. The 10k PULLDOWN sets the safe default --

g.text: the breakout module pulls them UP, so it drives the bus while the Pico's GPIO is still floating at boot.

g.desc: the breakout module pulls them UP, so it drives the bus while the Pico's GPIO is still floating at boot.

g.text: Bias 270R/270R holds the idle bus at ~330 mV differential (>200 mV, so RO is defined when nobody drives).

g.desc: Bias 270R/270R holds the idle bus at ~330 mV differential (>200 mV, so RO is defined when nobody drives).

g.text: Fit the 120R terminator ONLY at the two physical ends of the bus.

g.desc: Fit the 120R terminator ONLY at the two physical ends of the bus.

g.text: A/B leave on J1-14/15 (twist them) with a dedicated ground return on J1-9 -- separate wire from the pin-2

g.desc: A/B leave on J1-14/15 (twist them) with a dedicated ground return on J1-9 -- separate wire from the pin-2

g.text: power ground, so the ceiling lamp's 0.8 A return does not move the RS-485 reference.

g.desc: power ground, so the ceiling lamp's 0.8 A return does not move the RS-485 reference.

g.text: ULN COM -> +12V enables the internal flyback diodes (relay coils ~105-125 mA each).

g.desc: ULN COM -> +12V enables the internal flyback diodes (relay coils ~105-125 mA each).

g.text: VBAT: 100k/22k -> 14.4 V reads 2.6 V (full scale 18 V). Also the engine-running detector.

g.desc: VBAT: 100k/22k -> 14.4 V reads 2.6 V (full scale 18 V). Also the engine-running detector.

g.text: J2 = stock connector, JAE IL-AG5-22P-D3L2 (green 22P, ETM view 55). Pin numbers are the FACTORY ones.

g.desc: J2 = stock connector, JAE IL-AG5-22P-D3L2 (green 22P, ETM view 55). Pin numbers are the FACTORY ones.

g.text: Rows are unequal: 1-10 outer, 11-22 inner (12 contacts). Same 16 nets as J1 — fit one connector, not both.

g.desc: Rows are unequal: 1-10 outer, 11-22 inner (12 contacts). Same 16 nets as J1 — fit one connector, not both.

g.text: 1 RS-485 A (stock: no terminal; twist with 12)

g.desc: 1 RS-485 A (stock: no terminal; twist with 12)

g.text: 4 hood open, YEL/RED — security only, not fitted

g.desc: 4 hood open, YEL/RED — security only, not fitted

g.text: 5 disarm switch, BLU — security only, not fitted

g.desc: 5 disarm switch, BLU — security only, not fitted

g.text: 7 unlock relay stage, YEL/RED — dropped at rev 8

g.desc: 7 unlock relay stage, YEL/RED — dropped at rev 8

g.text: 9 siren, RED — security only, not fitted

g.desc: 9 siren, RED — security only, not fitted

g.text: 12 RS-485 B (stock: no terminal; twist with 1)

g.desc: 12 RS-485 B (stock: no terminal; twist with 1)

g.text: 19 RS-485 ground return (stock: no terminal; own wire, not pin 13)

g.desc: 19 RS-485 ground return (stock: no terminal; own wire, not pin 13)

g.text: 21 siren, WHT — security only, not fitted

g.desc: 21 siren, WHT — security only, not fitted

g.text: 10k pulldowns: RP2040 GPIOs float until setup() runs; a floating ULN input can fire a channel at boot.

g.desc: 10k pulldowns: RP2040 GPIOs float until setup() runs; a floating ULN input can fire a channel at boot.
